title: Content Sections

fields.label: Content Sections
fields.name: content_sections
fields.instructions: Build the page by adding blocks. Blocks render in the order listed.

sub_fields.label: Background Image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Abstract texture behind the hero. It is washed into the navy with a magenta glow, cropped to fill and drifts slowly. Leave empty for the glow alone.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Short uppercase label in a chip above the heading. Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: The main heading. Required: the hero is hidden without it. As the first block on a page this is the page's H1.

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: One or two sentences under the heading. Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Primary Button
sub_fields.name: primary_link
sub_fields.instructions: Solid magenta button with an arrow. Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Secondary Button
sub_fields.name: secondary_link
sub_fields.instructions: Outlined button beside the primary. Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Figures
sub_fields.name: stats
sub_fields.instructions: Up to three headline figures, shown in a row beside the copy on desktop and beneath it on smaller screens. Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: The figure itself, e.g. "4,000+". Rows without a value are skipped.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: What it counts, e.g. "Film references".

sub_fields.label: Background shape
sub_fields.name: background_shape
sub_fields.instructions: Faint faceted line-work behind this section, taken from the design. Cubes are an isometric lattice that fills the section height; triangles are a low-poly wireframe band centred vertically. Both fade out towards the middle of the page so they never sit under the text.

sub_fields.label: Background image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional texture behind the banner. The magenta wash and the fade into the next section are drawn either way, so leaving this empty is a valid choice.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small capitals above the heading, with a magenta dot.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: The page title. Rendered as the H1 when the banner is the first section on the page.

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: One or two sentences under the heading.

sub_fields.label: Show breadcrumb
sub_fields.name: breadcrumb
sub_fields.instructions: Home, any parent pages, then this page. Built from the page's own position in the menu structure.

sub_fields.label: Background shape
sub_fields.name: background_shape
sub_fields.instructions: Faint faceted line-work behind this section, taken from the design. Cubes are an isometric lattice that fills the section height; triangles are a low-poly wireframe band centred vertically. Both fade out towards the middle of the page so they never sit under the text.

sub_fields.label: Aurora line above
sub_fields.name: divider
sub_fields.instructions: Draw the thin aurora gradient line across the top of the section.

sub_fields.instructions: Drop the surface tint and the hairlines above and below, so the row sits straight on the page background. Use this when the strip already sits between two aurora lines.

sub_fields.label: Promises
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: One row per promise. Rows without a label are skipped.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Outline icon shown before the label.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Keep it to a few words so the row stays on one line.

sub_fields.label: Shape
sub_fields.name: ratio
sub_fields.instructions: The box the embed is drawn into, so it is the same shape on a phone as on a desktop. Choose the last one only when the embed sets its own height.

sub_fields.label: Background shape
sub_fields.name: background_shape
sub_fields.instructions: Faint faceted line-work behind this section, taken from the design. Cubes are an isometric lattice that fills the section height; triangles are a low-poly wireframe band centred vertically. Both fade out towards the middle of the page so they never sit under the text.

fields.label: Aurora line after the last section
fields.name: content_sections_end_rule
fields.instructions: Draw the thin aurora gradient line between the last section and the footer. The per-section "Aurora line above" switch can only draw a line above a section, so a closing line is set here.

description: Flexible content blocks. Layout name maps to inc/blocks/{name}.php. Shown on Pages, on product and category terms, and on Theme Settings > Product Pages, Category Pages, Search Page and 404 Page, where the sections are shared by every page of that kind.
